name: Attention Schema Theory (AST)
title: Attention Schema Theory (AST) — Cognitive-layer theoretical reference
description: Curated reference for the Attention Schema Theory (Graziano & Kastner 2011; Graziano 2013, 2019; Graziano et al. 2020). The brain constructs a simplified internal model of its own attentional state — the attention schema; subjective awareness is what this model reports about itself. AST treats the hard problem as a predicted property of an internal cartoon, not a fact about reality. Includes neuroanatomy (rTPJ, STS), empirical dissociations of attention vs. awareness, relation to GWT/IIT/PP/HOT, and critiques (Chalmers, Doerig).
core_concepts: standard-model unification with GWT, HOT, illusionism
empirical_targets: rTPJ lesion → neglect with preserved orienting
machine consciousness reports under attention-schema implementation
